game_concept: A strategy race set in The Kingdom – Dungeon Stairs, the castle dungeon stairwell: the baker's apprentice must handle goblin raiders while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Memory Map: Place variable cards on a memory board so the signal beacon reads the right value at run time.
theme: The Kingdom – Dungeon Stairs: the castle dungeon stairwell
core_gameplay_loop: In Dungeon Stairs, repeat each round: Place variable cards on a memory board so the signal beacon reads the right value at run time. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the baker's apprentice ahead. Then check the y value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the signal beacon by solving code steps involving y that move the baker's apprentice forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.5).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the signal beacon first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 1 (intro tier): Memory Map
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Memory Map' (Week 1 slot 9), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Dungeon Stairs'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how y changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against goblin raiders in Dungeon Stairs.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.5).
